draftBefore.emotion: warm and welcoming, talking about family
notes: In Dutch, 'nicht' has two completely different meanings: it can mean the daughter of your brother or sister (niece), or the daughter of your uncle or aunt (female cousin). Context usually makes it clear which one is meant.
Do not confuse 'nicht' with 'necht', which does not exist; the male counterparts are 'neef' for both nephew and male cousin.
